jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 181518 

 About Al-Futtaim
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
 
 Overview Of The Role: 

 The Senior Manager - Controlling at the Global Treasury Centre is a pivotal role designed to support the Head of Controlling in managing strategic treasury governance activities. This includes developing comprehensive frameworks for treasury governance, leading transformation initiatives, and implementing AI strategies to enhance treasury operations. The role demands a high level of coordination with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring compliance with audit standards, and driving innovation in treasury systems and processes. The incumbent will be responsible for providing actionable insights through detailed treasury reports and maintain performance alignment with financial goals. This role operates within a large, complex organizational structure and requires a proactive and flexible approach to problem-solving and stakeholder management.

 What You Will Do: 

 Treasury Governance and Compliance 
 
 Lead the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of Treasury governance frameworks, including Treasury Policies, SOPs, SLAs, DOAs, RACI matrix, and operating models.

 Ensure effective communication, adoption, and compliance across Global Treasury, GBS, and business divisions.

 Manage the annual review and timely closure of governance and compliance actions.

 Treasury Transformation and Process Excellence 
 
 Drive treasury transformation initiatives focused on standardization, automation, control enhancement, and operational efficiency.

 Govern strategic projects including Cash Pooling, In-House Bank, Trade Finance digitization, and Treasury technology initiatives.

 Ensure delivery of treasury projects on time and within budget while reducing manual effort and operational risk.

 Treasury AI Strategy & Innovation 
 
 Lead Treasury AI governance and innovation by establishing robust controls for AI development and deployment.

 Ensure compliance with stage-gate processes and drive adoption of AI-enabled reporting, analytics, and decision-support solutions.

 Partner with EIT and AI office to implement the AI Treasury strategy.

 Track compliance with AI governance framework and successful deployment of AI use cases.

 Treasury Reporting and Financial Control 
 
 Oversee the preparation, review, and analysis of Treasury reports, Treasury P&L, Balance Sheet positions, and treasury operating costs.

 Provide management with actionable insights.

 Ensure timely publication of Treasury Reports and alignment of performance with budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

 Maintain Treasury P&L and cost variances within agreed thresholds.

 Audit, Risk Management & Stakeholder Engagement 
 
 Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external audits.

 Maintain a strong treasury control environment.

 Ensure timely closure of audit findings and achieve zero repeat high-risk audit observations.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Advanced analytical skills and thorough understanding of treasury processes.

 Strong communication and presentation abilities.

 Experience with ERP systems, especially SAP TRM and Power BI.

 Proven ability to manage pressure, influence colleagues, and collaborate with stakeholders.

 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 CA, CFA, CPA, or equivalent certification is required; additional treasury coursework (ACT or similar) is beneficial.

 Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience within a large organization managing treasury operations and controls.

 Advanced knowledge in analytical treasury processes, banking, hedging, and trade finance.

 Proficiency in ERP systems, particularly SAP TRM, and data visualization tools like Power BI.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Finance
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

 1. Revenue Assurance & Controls 

 Ensure end‑to‑end revenue integrity across all business units—order‑to‑cash, billing, invoicing, and collections.

 Design, implement, and monitor strong internal controls to prevent revenue leakage.

 Lead periodic revenue reconciliation , variance analysis, and root-cause investigations.

 Review and validate pricing, contracts, discounts, promotions, and revenue adjustments.

 Drive compliance with IFRS and organizational policies for revenue recognition.

 2. Process Excellence & Transformation 

 Lead large-scale process transformation initiatives within the Shared Services Center to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and automation.

 Implement digital tools such as RPA, workflow automation, analytics dashboards, and AI/ML-based anomaly detection .

 Redesign workflows for standardization across geographies and businesses.

 Create KPIs and dashboards to measure performance, leakage, recovery, and process stability.

 3. Leadership & Stakeholder Management 

 Manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary team responsible for billing, audits, assurance checks, and reporting.

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—Finance, Operations, IT, Commercial, Data Analytics.

 Influence senior stakeholders with insights and recommendations backed by strong analytics.

 Partner with internal audit and external auditors on revenue-related reviews.

 4. Continuous Improvement & Value Creation 

 Identify systemic gaps in revenue processes and execute corrective actions.

 Develop a roadmap for shared services scalability and maturity .

 Introduce best practices from global Shared Services/GBS frameworks.

 Establish governance models for periodic business reviews and improvement cycles.

 5. Reporting & Analytics 

 Deliver accurate and timely revenue assurance MIS, dashboards, KPIs, and performance scorecards.

 Analyze trends, identify anomalies, and highlight risks/opportunities.

 Prepare executive-level presentations for senior leadership and CFO reviews.

 Chartered Accountant with 8-10 years of experience
 7–12 years of experience in Finance Shared Services , Revenue Assurance , or Order-to-Cash , with at least 3–5 years in a managerial role.
 Proven track record leading transformational or digitalization projects .
 Strong understanding of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics) and automation tools (Power BI, Power Automate, RPA).
 Solid grasp of internal controls, contract management, and financial governance.

jobs.title: Vice President – Asset Management (Commercial)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Lead the strategic management of Aldar's assigned commercial assets to maximize portfolio value, optimize financial performance, and enhance customer experience. Drive asset performance through leasing strategy, capital investment, service provider governance, sustainability initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration while supporting Aldar's long-term investment objectives.
The role is for the UAE national
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Asset & Portfolio Management
Develop and implement asset strategies to maximize long-term value and portfolio performance.
Drive portfolio optimization through asset repositioning, enhancement, and capital recycling initiatives.
Monitor market trends and asset performance to support strategic decision-making.
2. Financial Performance & Capital Management
Manage portfolio financial performance, including NOI, occupancy, yield, valuation, and total return.
Identify value creation opportunities and oversee annual business planning, budgeting, and financial reporting.
Support investment decisions through financial analysis and performance insights.
3. Leasing, Commercialisation & Tenant Experience
Lead leasing strategies to maximize occupancy, rental growth, and tenant retention.
Identify commercialisation opportunities and oversee tenant engagement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction and NPS.
Review key leasing transactions and ensure alignment with portfolio objectives.
4. Asset Enhancement & Development Coordination
Lead asset enhancement programmes and CAPEX initiatives to improve asset performance and customer experience.
Coordinate with Development, Legal, Finance, and Operations to ensure successful project delivery and asset handover.
Monitor post-completion performance against approved business cases.
5. Service Provider Governance
Oversee the performance of Property and Facilities Management service providers through agreed SLAs, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
Drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, and cost optimization across the portfolio.
6. Stakeholder & Portfolio Collaboration
Partner with internal business units, including Development, Finance, Legal, Retail, Hospitality, and Education, to deliver integrated portfolio initiatives.
Build and maintain effective relationships with tenants, brokers, consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders.
 
RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
Min of 10+ years of at least 5 years of experience in real estate, property and asset management, investment banking, buy side or sell side advisory or other related field.
 
YOE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION
Min of 2+ years in a related managerial position
 
FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
Banking, real estate consultancy, management consultancy.
 
TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency with standard software, including MS Office; advanced Excel skills is a must.
Proven track record in conducting valuation / financial models.
Able to analyze, evaluate and move quickly to support rapid decision making.
Ability to interpret and manage transaction documentation: NDAs, MoUs, LoI’s, and SPA’s
Ability to develop Board level papers and investment memoranda.
 
QUALIFICATION
Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance or Accounting, MBA (Finance), CFA, CA or CPA preferred.

Job Requisition ID: 181412 

 About Al-Futtaim 

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

Overview of the role
 
As the Financial Control Manager in Al Futtaim Retail Head Office and lead Central Retail Controlling tasks while complying with organization’s policies and procedures and ensuring necessary checks and balances to mitigate risks.

 What you will do
 
• Ensure compliance with Transfer pricing transactions, Balance Sheet / High Risk Accounts review considering multiple Inter-Company Transactions which are in conjunction with Finance Controls along with weekly / Monthly Reporting in line with Organization requirements. 
• Enhanced Month end closing reviews & timeline management with various stakeholders & support on balance sheet reviews, closed business active clean up, Misstatement proactive reviews & addressing fixes
• Lead, monitor & establish SLAs across Retail Brands including Cost Allocations, Loyalty Program Management, Revenue Recognition – Budget Vs. Actuals / True Ups, Accruals & Breakage Management 
• Proper implementation and ongoing compliance with IFRS 16 accounting standards for lease accounting & PPE, including tracking, updating & monitoring Reinstatement provisions & providing timely financial reporting and analysis wherever required
• Oversee & monitor critical areas such as Store Insurances, Gift Voucher / Promotion Management, Blue Loyalty Program, Cost Allocations & Inter Company transactions 
• Ensure compliance with corporate income tax regulations, including preparation & documentation, and any other required filings. assist in tax planning activities, including identifying opportunities for tax optimization, minimizing liabilities, and ensuring compliance with applicable tax laws & regulations. 
• Prepare & lead presentations with cross team / functional stakeholders on monthly & adhoc basis 
• Contribute to the Improvement, Identify Accounting & Financial issues & suggest timely solutions within the team & cross function with an aim to standardize accounting process (FSSC, O2C, Group Tax, Group Finance, P&C etc)
• Collaborate & lead discussions with external & internal auditors during audits, ensuring that all information is accurately reported & compliant with IFRS / Policy requirements
• Initiate, establish & support on AI initiatives within the team to optimize automation & address current / future automation opportunities.

 What Qualifies You For The Role 

• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline. Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, or CIMA is highly preferred
• 6-8 years of progressive experience in Financial Control, Financial Reporting, Audit, or Retail Finance within a large, complex organization.Familiarity with ERP systems, preferably SAP, and exposure to SAP BW/BPC/SAC.
• Strong knowledge of IFRS standards, particularly IFRS 15 (Revenue Recognition), IFRS 16 (Lease Accounting), and fixed asset accounting.
• Experience in developing automation initiatives using Power BI, Power Automate, AI tools, RPA, or other digital finance solutions is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Finance (Factory)
jobs.description:
Who we are:

GMG is a global well-being company retailing, distributing and manufacturing a portfolio of leading international and home-grown brands across sport, everyday goods, health and beauty, properties and logistics sectors. Under the ownership and management of the Baker family for over 45 years, GMG is a valued partner of choice for the world's most successful and respected brands in the well-being sector. Working across the Middle East, North Africa, and Asia, GMG has introduced more than 120 brands across 12 countries. These include notable home-grown brands such as Sun & Sand Sports, Dropkick, Supercare Pharmacy, Farm Fresh, Klassic, and international brands like Nike, Columbia, Converse, Timberland, Vans, Mama Sita's, and McCain.

Role Summary:
The Senior Manager – Finance (Factory) is responsible for managing end-to-end finance operations at the factory level, ensuring robust financial control, accurate reporting, and operational finance support to manufacturing operations. The role is hands-on and execution-focused, acting as the key finance partner to Factory Operations while ensuring alignment with GMG’s Group finance policies, controls, and standards. The role covers core operational finance pillars, with a strong emphasis on compliance, efficiency, and cost discipline within a manufacturing environment.

Key Success Drivers including Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

1. Financial Control & Compliance

Ensure strict adherence to GMG Group finance policies, internal controls, and governance frameworks at the factory level

Maintain strong financial discipline across all manufacturing transactions, including inventory, procurement, and production costing

Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring timely closure of audit findings and zero compliance gaps

Safeguard company assets through effective control mechanisms and regular reconciliations

2. Factory Financial Operations & Reporting

Oversee end-to-end factory finance operations, including month-end close, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations

Ensure timely, accurate, and insightful financial reporting aligned with Group timelines and standards

Monitor key financial metrics (cost per unit, yield, wastage, variances) and highlight risks and opportunities

Drive transparency and accuracy in inventory accounting and valuation

3. Cost Management & Efficiency

Partner with factory operations to drive cost optimization initiatives across materials, labor, and overheads

Analyze production costs, variances, and inefficiencies, providing actionable insights to improve margins

Track and control factory budgets, ensuring alignment with approved financial plans

Lead initiatives to improve productivity and reduce waste within the manufacturing process

4. Business Partnering with Factory Operations

People Management:

• Lead and develop the factory finance team.

• Allocate work, review outputs, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

• Build strong finance capability within the factory through coaching and on-the-job development.

• Promote a culture of accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement.

Functional/Technical Competencies:
Strong manufacturing finance knowledge (costing, BOM, variances, inventory)

Financial reporting & month-end close expertise

Cost control, margin analysis, and budgeting/forecasting

Internal controls, compliance, and audit management

ERP systems and advanced Excel skills

Data analysis and business partnering for decision support

Working capital and inventory management

Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.

• Master’s degree is an advantage.

Experience:
• 8–12 years of progressive experience in finance roles, with significant exposure to manufacturing or factory environments.

• Proven experience managing factory-level finance operations.

• Experience working in large, structured organizations with strong governance frameworks.

 Advanced corporate finance and investment analysis experience

 Excellent Excel modeling and PowerPoint drafting skills

 Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail

 High level of professional and personal ethical standards

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills (verbal and written), adept at building strong relationships and teamwork

 Strong time management capabilities

 Bachelor’s degree in finance, management or economics from a reputable university

 Professional financial qualification is preferred e.g., CFA, MBA, CIMA, CMA, CPA, etc.

 Monthly MIS

 Budget & Forecasts

 Business Support

 AI & Automation

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 181415 

 About Al-Futtaim
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
 
 Overview Of The Role: 

 The Finance Executive position plays a crucial role in financial planning, analysis, and decision-making within Hertz and Moov's Financial Services division. This role involves partnering with operational management to drive revenue, optimize costs, and improve financial performance. The Manager will provide financial guidance, prepare forecasts and budgets, and ensure alignment of financial plans with business objectives. Additionally, they will be involved in reporting, process enhancement, and supporting automation initiatives, ensuring compliance and continuous improvement within financial operations.

 What You Will Do: 

 Commercial Business Partnering & Decision Support 

 Partner proactively with Operation Management to evaluate and drive revenue, margin, cost saving initiatives, and fleet performance across Rental, Leasing, and Subscription business.

 Support in evaluating investment decisions: non-fleet CAPEX and fleet CAPEX.

 Manage Profit Center and Cost Center reporting with recommendations on cost/margin efficiency improvements of profit-generating and supporting business functions.

 Act as a financial thought partner in Leasing and Rental business reviews, challenging assumptions, stress-testing forecasts, and providing commercial perspectives on growth initiatives.

 Conduct commercial control of OPEX, Direct fleet associated cost, and manpower cost, including validation and assessment of purchase requisitions.

 Support in fleet utilization and optimization initiatives through analyses of channels, vehicle segments, products, seasonality patterns; revenue yield per unit, idle fleet cost; maintenance and sales cycle lead-times.

 Monitor, develop, and support the implementation of commercial KPIs in periodic reports/dashboards (daily/weekly), analyzing trends, highlighting deviations from targets and performance risks, and opportunities.

 Preparation of Forecasts and Budgets 

 Coordinate quarterly forecasts and planning exercises.

 Manage entity Cash Flow preparations and coordinate cash planning and transfers with Group Treasury.

 Prepare Monthly reporting packs, BRM (Business Review Meeting), and FRM (Finance review meeting) presentation decks.

 Enhance and automate management reporting, trend historical and forward-looking reporting via BI tools or other dashboard solutions.

 Perform ad hoc FP&A reporting and financial modeling as requested by the manager.

 Support requirements gathering, design, testing, and implementation of financial planning tools for Lease, Rental, and Subscription financial statements.

 Reporting & Analyses 

 Coordinate financial planning inputs from business functions, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business objectives.

 Prepare Monthly Financials pack for entities.

 Conduct mid-month forecasts as required.

 Maintain Group Financial reporting, planning, and analysis tools (upload Budget/Forecast/Flash/Strategic plans and other relevant schedules and reports).

 Provide periodic analysis of variances between financial plans and actual results, offering explanations for key revenue, cost, and margin drivers.

 Conduct Monthly, Quarterly, and Ad-hoc reporting for Lease, Rental, and Subscription divisions.

 Others 

 Develop, maintain, and enhance internal process controls and implement internal audit recommendations in collaboration with divisional Risk and Operations functions.

 Develop and customize reports in SAP/BI based on business requirements.

 Explore and implement process automation using modern tools like AI and BI.

 Ensure system development documentation access, revision, and validation; represent the Finance department in system testing cycles.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Advanced proficiency in AI tools, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and SAP.

 Knowledge and familiarity with IFRS accounting standards.

 Proven experience working in high-volume, transaction-intensive environments with large business scale and complexity.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and stress-test forecasts.

 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 Master's or bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Corporate Finance, or a related field.

 Professional accounting or finance certification such as CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent qualification.

 5+ years of experience as a Financial Business Partner and/or FP&A role within large multinational and diversified corporations.

 Experience in the leasing and rental industry, with an understanding of commercial, operational, and financial drivers; Automotive/Financial services experience is a plus.

jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE 

 •Provide independent commercial assurance across the D-Sell portfolio by reviewing, challenging and validating business cases, feasibility studies and commercial decisions.

 •Ensure investment decisions are supported by robust commercial analysis, market intelligence and governance before progressing through approval gateways.

 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Commercial Assurance & Investment Review

 •Independently review feasibility studies, business cases and project strategies.

 •Challenge commercial assumptions, financial models and investment propositions.

 •Validate commercial robustness and investment readiness prior to Investment Committee approvals.

 •Prepare independent commercial opinions to support executive decision-making.

 •Assess major commercial changes, variation orders and scope changes.

 •Support Gateway and Investment Committee governance processes.

 •Provide scenario analysis and independent recommendations for strategic investment decisions.

 Commercial Analysis & Continuous Improvement

 •Maintain commercial benchmarks across comparable developments and market sectors.

 •Perform market, cost and commercial benchmarking analyses.

 •Identify commercial risks, value enhancement opportunities and optimisation initiatives.

 •Standardise commercial assurance methodologies and continuously improve governance processes, reporting and analytical capabilities.

 Leadership & Capability Development

 •Lead and develop the Commercial Assurance function capability.

 •Foster a culture of independent challenge, collaboration and continuous improvement.

 •Promote consistent commercial governance and assurance practices across the portfolio.

 KEY MEASURES OF SUCCESS 

 •Commercial reviews completed within agreed SLA.

 •Reduction in commercial approval rework.

 •Accuracy of commercial assumptions.

 •Timely executive decision support.

 •Stakeholder satisfaction.

 Years of Experience 

 •14+ years in in development, commercial, investment or development finance.

 •6+ years managing commercial activities.

 Technical and Interpersonal Skills 

 •Financial Modelling

 •Feasibility and Investment Analysis

 •Commercial Negotiation

 •Market Research

 •Strong commercial acumen and critical thinker

 •Capable of building and nurturing partnerships across key stakeholders to obtain relevant information and provide firm recommendations

 •Excel / Power BI and embedding of AI tools in any work process

 Qualifications 

 •Bachelor's in Finance, Real Estate, Economics or Engineering.

 •Master's preferred.

 •CFA, MRICS or equivalent desirable.

 Job Purpose 

 The Assistant Vice President - Compliance is responsible for supporting the VP-Compliance in ensuring the Company’s adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, with primary responsibility for compliance matters relating to health insurance and the requirements of the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) and Department of Health (DOH) in Abu Dhabi. 

 The role will also support VP- Compliance in the implementation and monitoring of the Company’s overall compliance framework and in handling other matters as assigned. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 1. Health Insurance Regulatory Compliance – Primary Responsibility 

 Review products, policy terms, underwriting, enrolment, claims, pre-authorization, reimbursement and complaints for regulatory compliance. 

 Oversee compliance risks relating to provider networks, brokers, outsourcing partners and TPAs, including due diligence, contracts, service levels, data access and audit rights. 

 Monitor laws, regulations, standards, circulars, notices and other requirements issued by the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) and the Department of Health in Abu Dhabi and ensure coordination with the above authorities. 

 Coordinate with Health Insurance, Claims, Underwriting, Operations, IT and other relevant departments to ensure timely implementation of regulatory requirements.

 Coordinate and follow up on regulatory inspections, reviews, audits, observations and remediation actions relating to health insurance. 

 Monitor regulatory deadlines and ensure that required actions and submissions are completed within the prescribed timelines. 

 Escalate material compliance issues, regulatory breaches or implementation delays to the VP- Compliance.

 Execute risk-based reviews, report findings, establish accountable actions, validate closure and escalate material breaches. 

 Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence demonstrating compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. 

 Follow up with business units on agreed compliance remediation actions and report overdue or material matters to the VP- Compliance. 

 Assist VP- Compliance in preparing compliance reports, maintain regulatory records, deliver targeted training and support enterprise-wide compliance initiatives. 

 3. General Compliance Support 

 Monitor compliance with applicable insurance laws, regulations, standards and regulatory circulars. 

 Conduct regulatory gap assessments and support implementation of new regulatory requirements. 

 Review internal policies, procedures, products, agreements and business initiatives from a compliance perspective. 

 Support the preparation and updating of the Compliance Framework, Compliance Plan and related policies and procedures. 

 Perform any other compliance-related duties assigned by the VP- Compliance.

 Bachelor’s degree in law, Finance, Business, Insurance, Healthcare Administration or a related field; relevant professional qualification preferred. 

 Typically, 10–12 years’ relevant experience, including 5 years in a managerial or senior advisory role. 

 Strong knowledge of UAE insurance regulation and practical medical-insurance experience. 

 Experience with regulators, inspections, remediation and senior governance forums. 

 Understanding of medical underwriting, claims, provider contracting, TPAs, coding, billing, outsourcing and health-data risks.

 Orient Insurance Company commenced operations in 1982 as a part of the reputed Al-Futtaim Group and has since recorded a progressively steady growth. INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What you'll be doing  

On behalf of Christofle Paris, we are looking for a GCC Sales & Account Manager to represent Christofle and drive the Maison’s commercial development across the region, with a particular focus on Hospitality and Decorators.

Based in Dubai and reporting into Christofle’s Hospitality & Business Development team in Paris, this is a highly entrepreneurial Account Management and Business Development role. Your responsibilities will be to:

• Build and develop relationships with leading hotel groups, owners, developers, restaurant groups, procurement companies, architects, interior designers and decorators

• Identify new projects and commercial opportunities across the GCC

The Financial Analyst will provide comprehensive support to the BP&A Team in strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. jobs.description:

 Support residential/commercial asset performance through analysis, reporting and execution support.

 Monitor NOI, occupancy, leasing and asset performance against approved targets.

 Support asset enhancement, commercialization and value-creation initiatives.

 Leverage AI, analytics and market insights to strengthen asset-level analysis and decision support.

 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Asset Performance & Analysis 

 Monitor asset performance across NOI, occupancy, rental growth and key operational KPIs.

 Prepare asset performance reports, dashboards and variance analysis to support management decisions.

 Identify performance gaps and provide analysis to support corrective and value-enhancement actions.

 Maintain accurate asset-level financial, operational and performance data.

 Leasing & Commercial Support 

 Track leasing activity, renewals, expiries, occupancy, pricing and tenant/customer trends.

 Conduct market research and benchmarking on rents, occupancy, supply, pricing and competitor performance.

 Support analysis of commercialization and ancillary revenue opportunities.

 Support enhancement and repositioning initiatives, tracking delivery, CAPEX and performance against business cases.

 Real estate, property management, investment analysis.

 Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams.

 Application of AI and analytics to asset performance, forecasting and decision support.

 Bachelor's in Engineering, Finance, Economics, Real Estate or related. MBA or CFA progress advantageous.

 STRATEGIC 
 Work with the IT leadership team on IT strategic planning and take overall responsibility for the management and development of the Application requirements, liaising with key staff to ensure that services meet business needs 
 Keep abreast of new technological developments in Applications and present proposals with recommendations to senior management which would benefit the Business Unit and Group. Lead such transformation initiatives for the BU

 Develop Applications management processes with lean and efficient procedures in conjunction with other relevant teams 
 OPERATIONAL 
 Analyzing business operations and solutions to improve efficiencies

 Creating and overseeing protocols and procedures for the use of any new software applications

 PEOPLE MANAGEMENT 
 Partner and manage relationships with key external partners, project managers and team members, contractors, business stakeholders, to ensure integrated and successful delivery as a team 
 Manage team health addressing team conflicts, communication problems, etc.; and ensure that team and team members understand their roles, their goals and is fully motivated to perform

 Actively contribute in development of the team with target competencies and upskilling as required 
 Build industry relationships to stay abreast with latest developments, innovations and business direction 
 PRODUCT / PROCESS IMPROVEMENT

 Inculcate an agile mindset and ensure continuous improvements with multiple enhancements in line with the broader solution roadmap 
 
 EDUCATIONAL & TECHNICAL CERTIFICATIONS 
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science / IT 
 8+ years’ experience in managing and delivering technology solutions with specific experiences in healthcare 
 Project Management (PMP) certification is advantageous 
 KNOWLEDGE & SKILL 
 Strong process knowledge across multiple industries 
 Evidence of strong collaboration skills with excellent communication & interpersonal skills 
 A sound general Applications background with knowledge of industry standards 
 Excellent knowledge of ICT initiatives and developments. 
 Experience managing resources in a fast-moving environment and on projects with evolving requirements and accelerated timelines. 
 Strong project management skills (organization and time) 
 Self-learner/self-starter who can be immediately effective with ambiguity or a lack of direction.

 IT Project Management 
 Knowledge of system design, development, implementation, and user support principles and practices. Experience with database management. 
 Experience with Information system troubleshooting. 
 Demonstrated skill in developing automated business systems. 
 Ability to communicate technical information to a non-technical audience. 
 
 Advanced Skills Business Process Design 
 Knowledge of advanced systems analysis methods, practices, and principles. 
 Knowledge of cost modeling principles. 
 Experience leading and facilitating training (including preparation of training materials) 
 
 EXPERIENCE 
 Industry experience for multiple industries 
 Minimum of 4 years’ experience managing a team.

JOB PURPOSE
 
Play a key role in implementing corporate tax strategies, projects, and ensuring tax compliance within the corporate tax function of Aldar Group.
 
Provide M&A support and expertise from a corporate tax perspective.
 
 
The role is only for a UAE National. 
 
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
Collaborate with the AVP – Corporate Tax and wider tax team to execute comprehensive Corporate tax strategies aligned with the group's objectives and regulatory requirements.
 
Assist in the review of the monthly tax provision calculation produced by the system, reconciling it to the ledger.
 
Participate in the end-to-end annual Corporate tax compliance process, ensuring the accurate and timely filing of all tax returns.
 
Conduct detailed reviews of deferred tax calculations for the group, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and regulations.
 
Lead transfer pricing initiatives, ensuring compliance with international guidelines and recommending strategies to optimize the company's global tax position.
 
Provide tax expertise during mergers, acquisitions, and corporate transactions, including due diligence, structuring, and post-transaction integration.
 
Assist in Country-by-Country Reporting (CBCR), Pillar 2 and Transfer Pricing (TP) initiatives in Direct / Corporate Tax.
 
Support Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) compliance.
 
Offer guidance on cross-border tax matters, including international tax planning, treaty analysis, and preparation of transfer pricing documentation.
 
Stay updated on changes in domestic and international tax laws and regulations, ensuring the organization's tax practices remain compliant and current.
 
Prepare and review tax-related financial reports and disclosures, including tax provision calculations.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, external advisors, and tax authorities to address tax-related inquiries, audits, and projects efficiently.
 
 
RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
 
Min of: 2+ years of experience of experience in Accounting, mergers and acquisitions, and/or consultancy. 
 
 
FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
 
Experience in real estate industry
 
knowledge of accounting standards, tax laws and regulations.
 
 
TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
 
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
 
Effective team player with the capacity to manage multiple projects concurrently.
 
 
QUALIFICATION
 
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

jobs.title: Manager Recruitment - Revenue & Commercial
jobs.description:
The Opportunity 
 Etihad Airways is continuing an ambitious period of international growth, expanding our network, commercial reach, and global workforce.
 We’re looking for an experienced Manager Recruitment to join our Talent Acquisition team and lead recruitment across a portfolio of revenue & commercial functions. This is a highly visible role partnering with senior leaders to identify, attract, and secure talent across multiple international markets.
 You’ll operate in a fast-moving, complex environment where hiring requirements can span countries, functions, and levels of seniority. While experience recruiting within aviation would be valuable, it isn’t essential. We’re particularly interested in recruiters who have developed their careers within large, international organizations and complex matrix structures , and who understand what it takes to recruit globally.
 The role is hands-on. You’ll own searches yourself, build international talent pipelines, advise leaders on the external market, and increasingly use AI-enabled sourcing and recruitment technology to identify talent that traditional sourcing approaches may not reach.
 For someone who enjoys challenging searches, international recruitment, senior stakeholder engagement, and experimenting with new ways of finding talent, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Etihad continues to grow.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead end-to-end recruitment across a portfolio of commercial roles, from workforce planning and search strategy through assessment, offer, and onboarding.
 Partner with senior business leaders and HR Business Partners, acting as a trusted advisor on talent availability, market dynamics, sourcing strategy, and hiring decisions.
 Develop and execute international sourcing strategies , identifying talent across multiple geographic markets and industries.
 Build proactive pipelines for critical and recurring talent requirements rather than relying solely on active applicants.
 Use AI-enabled sourcing platforms, recruitment technology, talent intelligence, and traditional sourcing channels to identify and engage high-quality passive talent.
 Recruit across a range of commercial disciplines, with experience hiring sales and commercially focused talent particularly valuable.
 Navigate a complex, matrixed organization, balancing the requirements of multiple stakeholders while maintaining pace and quality.
 Bring external market intelligence to hiring conversations, helping leaders understand talent availability, competitor activity, and alternative talent pools.
 Ensure candidates are assessed consistently and objectively using Etihad’s recruitment and assessment methodologies.
 Champion an engaging, transparent candidate experience and represent Etihad effectively in international talent markets.

What we’re looking for 
 We’re looking for an experienced recruiter who combines strong recruitment fundamentals with curiosity about how technology and AI are changing talent acquisition.
 Ideally, you’ll bring:
 7+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience , with significant experience gained within a large, international organization.
 Demonstrated experience operating within a complex, matrixed organizational environment , partnering with stakeholders across different functions, countries, and levels of seniority.
 Strong experience delivering international recruitment , including proactively sourcing and engaging candidates across multiple geographic markets.
 Hands-on experience using AI-enabled sourcing tools, talent intelligence platforms, or other emerging recruitment technologies to identify and engage talent.
 Proven proactive sourcing capability, including experience identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on applications.
 Experience recruiting commercial talent; sales recruitment experience would be particularly advantageous .
 Strong stakeholder management skills, including the credibility to advise and influence senior leaders.
 Experience managing complex or challenging searches in competitive talent markets.
 A strong understanding of contemporary talent acquisition practices, including sourcing, assessment, candidate experience, recruitment technology, and talent pipelining.
 Excellent written and spoken English.
 Experience within aviation, travel, cargo, hospitality, or another international consumer-facing organization would be advantageous, but we’re equally interested in recruiters from other complex global businesses who can demonstrate the right recruitment capability and commercial mindset.

Recruitment Process 
 The recruitment process for this position will involve the following steps:
 All applications will be reviewed by a human-member of our Recruitment Team
 Shortlisted applicants will be invited to completed an AI-lead video interview via our third-party platform. This interview will allow you to record your responses to a range of questions related to the position and will allow you to demonstrate your knowledge and experience in a way that just your CV alone would not be able to. It also ensures fairness for you and all candidates, as all of our shortlisted candidates are asked the same questions and assessed on their responses. Whilst AI is utilized as part of the process, all responses will be reviewed by a human member of our recruitment team 
 After a review of completed video interviews, shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial technical interview with the hiring manager. 
 Finalists will be invited to a follow-up interview with additional members of the hiring team - this may involve the completion of a brief business case assignment
 All candidates will be notified as to the status of their application as soon as is possible.
 
 Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

jobs.description:
Synopsis
 As Product Specialist – Cargo Digital Systems, you will support the delivery, enhancement, and day-to-day evolution of Etihad Cargo’s digital platforms and commercial systems ecosystem, with a strong focus on the Cargo Booking Website, API integrations, and internally developed digital applications.
 You will work closely with Product Owners, Cargo business stakeholders, DT&I, vendors, and development teams to gather requirements, define solutions, coordinate deliveries, perform testing activities, and support continuous product improvements.
 The role combines product analysis, business process understanding, technical coordination, and hands-on support for digital product development initiatives. You will contribute to Agile product delivery while supporting the development and enhancement of web applications built primarily using JavaScript and React technologies.
 This role is ideal for candidates with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities who are interested in developing broader technical, digital product, and application development skills.
 Accountabilities
 • Prioritize and coordinate the delivery of bug fixes, enhancements, and new releases for Cargo systems in collaboration with DT&I and Cargo stakeholders across Commercial and Operations.

• Support the delivery of enhancements, fixes, integrations, and new features across Etihad Cargo digital platforms and Cargo systems.

• Act as a key contributor for the Etihad Cargo Booking Website, supporting feature enhancements, business requirements gathering, testing activities, and coordination with vendors and developers.

• Support integration projects between Cargo systems, customer platforms, and third-party applications.

• Assist in the design, coordination, and delivery of small internal applications, automation tools, and operational support solutions.

• Gather and document business requirements from Commercial, Revenue Management, Pricing, Sales, Operations, Customs, and Ground Handling stakeholders.

• Translate business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and process flows.

• Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives.

• Coordinate closely with DT&I teams, vendors, and developers to ensure requirements and priorities are clearly understood.

• Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, and validation of delivered functionalities.

• Track defects, support issue analysis, and coordinate resolution activities with vendors and technical teams.

• Support monitoring of product usage, operational KPIs, and user feedback to identify improvement opportunities.

• Contribute to UX improvements by supporting the design of intuitive and efficient user workflows.

• Support lightweight technical activities such as data analysis, API testing, configuration validation, and basic scripting/automation initiatives.

• Assist in maintaining documentation including release notes, process documentation, test scenarios, and knowledge articles.

• Ensure solutions comply with Etihad standards related to security, governance, and operational reliability.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related discipline.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in product analysis, digital products, system support, or business systems environments, preferably within cargo, aviation, logistics, or e-commerce industries.

• Good understanding of Agile methodologies such as Scrum or SAFe.

• Familiarity with web technologies such as JavaScript, React, APIs, JSON, or modern web applications is preferred.

• Experience supporting digital platforms, customer portals, or API integrations is an advantage.

• Experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, and release coordination.

• Basic knowledge of SQL, Python, Power BI, or automation tools is advantageous.

• Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination abilities.

• Ability to work across business and technical teams in a collaborative environment.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

Support the timely and accurate financial close, consolidation and reporting of multiple entities and ledgers in accordance with IFRS and Group requirements
 
Assist in maintaining financial data and general ledger integrity, including reconciliations, financial statements and audit requirements
 
Support the use of AI-enabled and digital finance tools to improve reporting efficiency, accuracy and financial analysis
 
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
Group Consolidation & Financial Reporting
Support monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation and financial reporting
 
Assist with reporting submissions, account mapping, intercompany eliminations and Group-level adjustments
 
Prepare consolidation schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation
 
Coordinate with subsidiaries and finance teams for accurate, timely information

Financial Close & General Ledger
Support monthly, quarterly and annual close across assigned entities and ledgers
 
Prepare journals, accruals, provisions, reclassifications and period-end adjustments
 
Assist in reviewing trial balances and identifying accounting or reporting discrepancies
 
Support accurate account mapping and financial reporting classifications

Reconciliations & Financial Controls
Prepare and review general ledger, balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations
 
Follow up on outstanding reconciliation items and support timely resolution
 
Assist in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation
 
Support compliance with Group policies, internal controls and reporting procedures

Audit & Compliance
Support internal and external audits with schedules, reconciliations, financial statements and documentation
 
Assist in responding to audit queries and coordinating required information
 
Support compliance with IFRS, statutory requirements and Group financial policies

Financial Analysis & Management Reporting
Assist in preparing variance analysis, financial analysis and management reports
 
Support analysis of performance against budget, forecast and prior periods
 
Prepare supporting analysis and commentary on key financial movements
 
Assist with budget, forecast and cash-flow reporting requirements

AI, Digital & Process Improvement
Use approved AI-enabled, analytics and digital tools to support reconciliations, financial reporting and analysis
 
Assist in identifying opportunities to automate repetitive finance activities
 
Support improvements to reporting processes, controls and ERP workflows
 
Apply appropriate validation and review to AI-generated outputs and insights
 
 
RELATED YEAR OF EXPERIENCE
Min of 6+ years of experience of financial accounting and management accounting experience
 
FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
Experience of accounting within real estate or related industry is preferred
 
Experience in complex Group-wide accounting and reporting, preferably in a public company
 
TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
Good knowledge of financial accounting, IFRS and financial reporting principles.
 
Good understanding of general ledger, reconciliations and consolidation processes.
 
Proficiency in ERP systems, Excel and financial reporting tools; Oracle experience preferred.
 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with accuracy and attention to detail.
 
Working knowledge of AI-enabled and digital finance tools for analysis, reporting and process efficiency
 
Good communication, stakeholder coordination and time-management skills.
 
 
QUALIFICATION
 
Bachelor’s degree in accounting
 
Professional accounting qualification e.g., CPA, CIMA, CA, ACCA  is preferred

jobs.description:
The Assistant Manager - Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is responsible for overseeing financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and MIS reporting to support strategic decision-making and enhance financial performance. This role involves analyzing financial data, ensuring data integrity, optimizing budgeting processes, and providing key financial insights to management. The position also plays a crucial role in cost control, risk assessment, and compliance with financial regulations to drive the organization’s profitability and long-term growth.
 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITY 
 Financial Planning & Analysis:
 • Conduct financial analysis and reporting to identify trends, variances, and performance metrics, providing actionable insights for management.
 • Assist in the development of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-term financial projections to align with business objectives.
 • Perform variance analysis, comparing actual financial results against budgets and forecasts, and recommend corrective actions.
 • Support cost analysis and profitability assessments to drive cost-saving initiatives and process optimization.
 
 Management Reporting & Data Analysis: 
 • Prepare and present accurate MIS reports, including store-wise Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, Balance Sheets, and other financial reports.
 • Ensure the timely month-end closing of financial reports and modules in accounting systems.
 • Evaluation of CAPEX proposals and store feasibility
 • Perform ledger scrutiny, trial balance reviews, and general ledger reconciliation to ensure data accuracy.
 • Assist in managing insurance processes for retail outlets, assets, warehouses, and offices.
 
 Budgeting & Forecasting: 
 • Assist in preparing budgets and forecasts, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
 • Develop and maintain financial models to support business decisions, investment planning, and risk management.
 • Support the monthly reconciliation of intercompany transactions and accounts to ensure financial integrity.
 
 Compliance & Risk Management: 
 • Monitor financial compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
 • Ensure risk management processes are in place to safeguard financial health.
 • Assist in audit processes and internal financial assessments to maintain accuracy and transparency.
 DESIRED EXPERIENCE 
 The ideal Assistant Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis should have 5-7 years of experience in Management Information Systems (MIS) or IT management, with experience in a leadership role.
 Proficiency in database management, data analysis, and ERP systems.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
 KEY RELATIONSHIPS 
 Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis, Business Teams, Functional departments, Executive - MIS & Business Analyst, Manager - Accounts and Finance, Treasury Operations Team, Purchase Team, Manager - Tax, etc.

• Proven experience selling trucks in the United Arab Emirates.

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE 
Manager - Internal Audit | Retail | Internal Audit

 ROLE SUMMARY 
The Internal Audit Manager will lead and execute audits across MAF Group operations and financial processes, generating insights that strengthen operational efficiency, risk management and internal controls. The role carries accountability for managing one or more audit engagements or a risk-focused portfolio within the Group and for promoting best practices across the business.

 ROLE PROFILE 
 Contribute to the development of the annual risk-based Internal Audit Plan, aligned with corporate strategy, Audit & Risk Committee (ARC) priorities, and emerging risks.
 Lead the planning and execution of end-to-end risk-based audit engagements across critical business operations including supply chain, procurement, finance, HR etc.
 Design audit programs, risk & control matrices, and testing procedures in line with IIA International Standards and internal audit best practice.
 Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls and identify gaps in governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC).
 Prepare/review audit workpapers and evidence to ensure quality, accuracy, and completeness of conclusions prior to reporting.
 Draft clear, insight-driven audit reports and present findings, root causes, and recommendations to business and senior stakeholders.
 Partner with process owners to agree realistic, risk-prioritized management action plans and track timely remediation.
 Coordinate with second-line functions (Risk, Compliance, QA) and external assurance providers to strengthen combined assurance and avoid duplication.
 
 REQUIREMENTS 
 10-12 years of progressive experience in Internal Audit, External Audit, Risk Management, or a related assurance discipline, including experience in leading audit teams and complex engagements.
 Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration or a related discipline
 Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CA or CIA.
 Strong knowledge of risk-based audit methodology, internal controls frameworks and regulatory or compliance requirements

 At Majid Al Futtaim, we’re on a mission to create great moments, to spread happiness, to build, experiences that stay in our memories for a lifetime. We’re proud to say that over the past 27 years, we have built a reputation as a regional market leader in what we do. Join us!
 Work in a friendly environment, where everyone shares positive vibes and excited about our future.
 Work with over 45,000 diverse and talented colleagues, all guided by our Leadership Model.

 The Senior AML Analyst is responsible for assisting the Compliance Department in establishing and implementing internal procedures related to Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), Counter-Proliferation Financing (CPF), Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), and Common Reporting Standard (CRS). The role supports the Compliance Department in ensuring that an appropriate framework, governance structure, and controls are in place to maintain compliance across the Insurance Division in line with applicable AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA & CRS regulatory requirements.

 Develop, implement, review, and enhance AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS policies and procedures.

 Provide guidance and mentoring to AML Analysts and support knowledge sharing within the compliance team.

jobs.title: Senior Executive - Accounts Receivable
jobs.description:
The Senior Executive - Receivable is responsible for efficiently managing accounts receivable processes, ensuring financial accuracy, and supporting reconciliation, reporting, and compliance activities. This role involves coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to maintain seamless financial operations, process payments, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency. The position plays a key role in ensuring accurate reconciliation of sales, deposits, and payments while maintaining adherence to audit and company policies. 
 Responsibility: 
 Manage end-to-end Accounts Receivable operations , including customer creation, invoicing, receivables accounting, ageing analysis, collections and account reconciliations. 
 Monitor customer outstanding balances and overdue receivables , ensuring timely follow-up and resolution of payment issues. 
 Perform customer ledger reconciliations , investigate discrepancies and ensure accurate allocation of receipts against outstanding invoices. 
 Coordinate with sales, commercial and operations teams to resolve billing disputes, inventory reconciliation, credit notes, pricing differences and other collection-related issues. 
 Prepare and monitor AR ageing reports, collection reports and daily/weekly outstanding statements for management review. 
 Ensure timely posting and reconciliation of customer receipts , including bank and other payment channels. 
 Support credit control activities , including customer credit limits, payment terms and escalation of overdue accounts. 
 Follow up with customers for pending invoices, payment confirmations and remittance details . 
 Assist in month-end closing , including AR reconciliation, provisions for doubtful debts, ageing review and balance sheet schedules. 
 Maintain accurate customer master data and ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls and accounting standards . 
 Support internal and external audits by providing AR schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents and explanations for outstanding balances. 
 Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation to improve collection efficiency and reduce overdue receivable
